set.body: From the review of the names-and-deixis slice (10ae4c5f5): MeasuredDetector threshold is caller-chosen, so MeasuredDetector(0, 0, receipt) certifies presence with zero recall, and recall is one number for the whole coverage, not per interval. Decide a floor (a policy-owned minimum threshold) and whether recall must be per interval before any detector is admitted for S3c.
set.title: [evidence-binding] Presence detector threshold floor and per-interval recall
